overview: The Residential Quarter houses the families and civic workers of Katta Castellum, forming the backbone of Loyalist daily life.
history: Built during the early Loyalist settlement to provide stable civic housing.
Terraced homes were designed to withstand arcane resonance from nearby districts.
Communal courtyards became centers of civic gatherings and festivals.
Arcane regulators were added to maintain infrastructure harmony.
hooks: A family reports strange arcane pulses in their home.
A census officer requests help verifying residency records.
A terrace walkway collapses during peak foot traffic.
A missing child is last seen near the communal fountain.
